summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Walter Schneiter, a Swiss football forward who lived from 2 July 1923 to 2 September 1972. It states that he played for Switzerland at the 1950 FIFA World Cup and also played club football for FC Zürich.
one_line: Walter Schneiter was a Swiss football forward who played for Switzerland at the 1950 FIFA World Cup and for FC Zürich.
key_facts: Walter Schneiter was born on 2 July 1923.
Walter Schneiter was a Swiss football forward.
Walter Schneiter played for Switzerland in the 1950 FIFA World Cup.
Walter Schneiter also played for FC Zürich.
